title: 第一卷 第6章 再让你的手装逼，就剁了他！
lines: 紫府境啊。
那可是号称真人。
紫府真人！
听着就威风。
陈渊知晓这修行境界的尊称。
灵窍境为小修士。
法体境为大修士。
黄庭境为道人。
紫府境为真人。
在这穷乡僻壤的地方，出现一位紫府真人？
那还了得？
看来，青山村也不能久留了。
陈渊心中暗自思忖。
“你是这里的村民？”
这时，那少女忽然对着陈渊开口。
陈渊看向她，微微颔首。
“啊，对了，阿渊，这是我的救命恩人，叫陈昭宁。”
李伟这才反应过来，连忙指着少女，满脸感激的道，“是她救了我。”
陈渊看向陈昭宁，警惕道：“区区灵窍境修士，能从黑山姥姥眼皮底下把你救出来？”
此话一出，陈昭宁神色愈发警惕，手中长刀依旧紧握：“你也是修士？”
她扫了一眼村落，疑惑开口，“这里竟然还有修士？”
陈渊没有理会她，而是看向李伟。
“这一切说来话长，阿渊，有没有吃的？”
李伟咽了咽口水，嘴唇苍白地问道。
陈渊再次看了眼陈昭宁。
“我保证，她绝对是好人！”
李伟拍着胸脯道。
他似乎极其信任那少女。
“好，我信你，跟我来。”
陈渊点头，将两人带回了住处。
“阿渊哥，谁呀？”
糯米睡眼惺忪，揉着眼睛从自己房间走出。
她裹着一件破旧的花棉袄，疑惑地看向李伟和陈昭宁。
“哇，好漂亮的大姐姐。”
她眼睛瞬间亮了起来，又看向李伟，“好可爱的大哥哥。”
被人说可爱，他还是头一回。
他立刻露出讨好的笑容：“我叫李伟，小妹妹，你叫什么呀？”
“我叫糯米。”
糯米脆生生地应道，下意识看了眼陈渊。
“他是我的发小。”
陈渊道。
“发小是什么？”
糯米眨巴着大眼睛，好奇问道。
“嗯，就是从小一起长大的兄弟。”
陈渊说完，便往灶房去看还有没有吃的。
糯米见状，也连忙给两人倒了杯水。
李伟和陈昭宁大口喝下，脸色才舒缓了不少。
接下来，陈渊一边煮粥，一边和李伟有一搭没一搭地聊着，询问对方是如何来到这个世界的？
原来，在李伟模糊的记忆里，他好像是被一个叫无相门的官方势力，从神魔遗迹里挖出来的。
当时无相门将他当成上古遗种，进行了各种试验。
比如灌入各种兽血神药。
后来，李伟承受不住，死了，便被无相门送给黑山姥姥当祭品。
没想到，李伟竟死而复生。
content_zh:
“没事，他不会伤害你们。”

    陈渊看向李伟，郑重开口。

    随即心中满是疑惑。

    陆大叔，跟一棵树打架？

    “好……好吧。”

    李伟咽了咽口水，心中虽发怵，也只能无奈点头。

    他相信陈渊不会害他。

    随即又向陈昭宁点头保证。

    陈昭宁看在小糯米的份上，只好螓首微点。

    都到了这里，纵然陆大叔不是正常人，她也无力再逃了。

    ……

    今晚陈渊和李伟睡一张床，糯米和陈昭宁睡一张床。

    至于陆承锋，则待在自己房间里，一直没有出现。

    里面没有呼吸声，也没有任何动静，仿佛根本没人。

    可李伟和陈昭宁可以肯定，陆承锋进去之后，确实没有出来过。

    ……

    房间里。

    陈渊和李伟在异世界重逢，李伟格外兴奋，拉着陈渊低声交谈。

    一来是害怕陆承锋，二来也实在是激动。

    隔壁房间，糯米和陈昭宁的声音也时不时传来。

    一直到凌晨两三点，实在困得不行，陈渊才懒得理会李伟，独自睡了过去。

    没多久，隔壁的糯米也睡熟了，轻轻打着鼾，嘴里还迷糊地念叨着好吃好吃这些呓语。

    ···········

    可初来乍到的李伟和陈昭宁，却是辗转难眠。

    直到红月高挂，远处山林传来一阵阵婴儿的嘶哭声，格外响亮，也极度瘆人。

    一直睡不着的两人，忽然听到客厅里传来窸窸窣窣的声响，瞬间紧张起来。

    “阿渊……阿渊……”

    李伟轻轻捅着身旁的陈渊，低低的开口。

    他的声音发颤，身子缩在被窝里瑟瑟发抖。

    陈渊睡在外侧，没有理他，却已经清醒。

    他感觉到有人靠近，就站在床前，一动不动。

    对方的影子透过窗户的暗红月光，笼罩在他脸上。

    陈渊紧闭双眼，被窝里的拳头紧握。

    他虽知道陆承锋不会害他，可难保对方会失去理智。

    旁边的李伟竭力装作熟睡，可身躯抖得厉害，心脏怦怦狂跳，几乎要从嗓子眼里蹦出来。

    陈渊深吸一口气，有些无奈。

    李伟刚醒没多久，会害怕很正常。

    他已经在这世界待了一年，又是灵窍大圆满境界，自是不怕。

    此刻，那道魁梧身影缓缓靠近，一股刺骨的杀意弥漫开来，房间温度骤降！

    “不会吧？”

    陈渊心中一沉。

    外面的婴儿哭声陡然消失，四周死寂一片！

    房间里静得只剩下隔壁糯米轻微的鼾声。

    陈渊和李伟都感到极度压抑，精神紧绷到极致！

    他们仿佛听到那魁梧身影，微微吸鼻子的声音。

    甚至能想象出他在龇牙的模样。

    像是闻到了无比诱人的食物，想吃，又不忍心下口。

    这让两人更加紧张，手心全是冷汗。

    只不过，对方迟迟没有动手。

    陈渊一直保持着随时反抗的姿态，精神高度紧绷，额头渗出一层细密冷汗。

    静！

    压抑！
content_en:
"It's okay, he won't hurt you."

Chen Yuan looked at Li Wei and spoke solemnly.

Then he was filled with doubts.

Uncle Lu, fighting with a tree?

"Okay...okay."

Li Wei swallowed, and although he was frightened, he could only nod helplessly.

He believed that Chen Yuan would not harm him.

Then he nodded his assurance to Chen Zhaoning.

For Xiao Nuomi's sake, Chen Zhaoning had no choice but to nod slightly.

Now that they are here, even though Uncle Lu is not a normal person, she can no longer escape.

…

Tonight Chen Yuan and Li Wei will sleep in the same bed, and Nuomi and Chen Zhaoning will sleep in the same bed.

As for Lu Chengfeng, he stayed in his room and never showed up.

There was no breathing or movement inside, as if there was no one at all.

But Li Wei and Chen Zhaoning were certain that after Lu Chengfeng went in, he never came out.

…

in the room.

Chen Yuan and Li Wei reunited in a different world. Li Wei was particularly excited and pulled Chen Yuan to talk in a low voice.

Firstly, he was afraid of Lu Chengfeng, and secondly, he was really excited.

In the next room, the voices of Nuomi and Chen Zhaoning could be heard from time to time.

It wasn't until two or three in the morning that Chen Yuan was so sleepy that he didn't bother to pay attention to Li Wei and fell asleep alone.

Not long after, Nuomi next door also fell asleep, snoring lightly and mumbling vaguely about how delicious it was.

···········

But Li Wei and Chen Zhaoning, who had just arrived, couldn't sleep.

Until the red moon was high in the sky, and the sound of babies crying could be heard from the mountains and forests in the distance, which was extremely loud and extremely scary.

The two people, who had been unable to sleep, suddenly heard a rustling sound coming from the living room, and they instantly became nervous.

"A Yuan...A Yuan..."

Li Wei gently poked Chen Yuan beside him and spoke in a low voice.

His voice was trembling, and his body was shivering in the bed.

Chen Yuan was sleeping outside and ignored him, but he was already awake.

He felt someone approaching and stood motionless in front of the bed.

The shadow of the other party shrouded his face through the dark red moonlight through the window.

Chen Yuan closed his eyes tightly and clenched his fists under the quilt.

Although he knew that Lu Chengfeng would not harm him, there was no guarantee that the other party would lose his mind.

Li Wei next to him tried his best to pretend to be asleep, but his body was shaking violently and his heart was beating so fast that it almost jumped out of his throat.

Chen Yuan took a deep breath, feeling helpless.

It was normal for Li Wei to be scared not long after he woke up.

He has been in this world for a year, and he is in the Great Perfection state of the spiritual aperture, so he is not afraid.

At this moment, the burly figure slowly approached, a biting murderous intent filled the air, and the temperature of the room dropped sharply!

"No way?"

Chen Yuan's heart sank.

The cry of the baby outside suddenly disappeared, and there was deathly silence all around!

The room was so quiet that only Nuomi's slight snoring could be heard next door.

Both Chen Yuan and Li Wei felt extremely depressed and tense to the extreme!

They seemed to hear the burly figure sniffing slightly.

You can even imagine him baring his teeth.

It's like smelling extremely tempting food and wanting to eat it, but not having the heart to take it.

This made the two of them even more nervous, and their palms were covered in cold sweat.

However, the other party has not yet taken action.

Chen Yuan always maintained a posture of resisting at any time, his spirit was highly tense, and a thin layer of cold sweat broke out on his forehead.

quiet!

Depressed!
